prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1242; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from the cross street pulled out and struck the side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and I felt my head snap to one side before the airbags deployed. I stopped as soon as I could, checked on my passenger, and called the police from the scene. I have given the same description of how the collision happened to the officer, to the adjuster, and to the medical staff who saw me afterward. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating the vehicle with the owner's permission at the time. Since the accident I have been treated for a neck strain, with stiffness and soreness that limit my movement, and I am following the treatment plan my doctor recommended.
